highlights.title: How Anthropic Learned Mythos Was Too Dangerous for the Wild
highlights.description: The AI company’s own experts warned Mythos could hack the systems beneath most modern computing. Banks and government agencies are racing to gauge the threat.

highlights.title: Apple and Google are reportedly pointing users to 'nudify' apps
highlights.description: Earlier this year it was revealed that Apple and Google were offering "nudify" apps on their stores despite having clear policies barring such content. Nearly three months later, such apps are not only still available, but being actively promoted on the iOS App Store and Google Play, according to a new report from the Tech Transparency Project (TTP). highlights.title: TSMC Raises 2026 Outlook in Sign of Confidence in AI Demand
highlights.description: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. raised its revenue outlook for 2026, an upbeat forecast that underscores the resilience of AI chip demand despite concerns about the economic fallout from the Middle Eastern conflict.

highlights.title: Opera adds Browser Connector for integrating AI chatbots
highlights.description: Opera is offering a new choice for looping in an AI assistant during browsing. Today, the company introduced Browser Connector, which allows Opera One and Opera GX users to integrate either ChatGPT or Claude into the platform. The chatbots will be able to access page content while a person is browsing and will draw context for queries from the information in your open tabs. highlights.title: TSMC first-quarter profit rises 58%, beats estimates as AI demand fuels record run
highlights.description: TSMC reported another quarter of record profit, with the company expecting AI demand to continue to grow.

highlights.title: TSMC's Profit Surges as AI Investment Boosts Demand
highlights.description: TSMC booked a 58% surge in profit, a sign that the Middle East war in its first few weeks did not depress booming AI investment. Bloomberg's Charlotte Yang reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Musk Asks Suppliers to Move at ‘Light Speed’ on New Chipmaking Plan
highlights.description: Elon Musk’s lieutenants have reached out to chip industry suppliers including Applied Materials Inc., Tokyo Electron Ltd. and Lam Research Corp. for his envisioned Terafab, early steps in an audacious and likely arduous attempt to break into the production of cutting-edge chips.

highlights.title: Apple Stores Will Soon Be Able to Restore Apple Watch Software In-House
highlights.description: Apple retail locations and Apple Authorized Service Providers will soon be able to restore Apple Watch software in-store without needing to send an Apple Watch to a service center, according to a retail source that spoke to MacRumors. Right now, Apple Watches that can't be restored using an iPhone need to be mailed to an Apple Repair Center for service. highlights.title: What Happens When $90 Billion of Data Centers Come to Town
highlights.description: Big Tech companies say northern Spain’s AI buildout is going so well, it should be a model for other parts of the EU. For local residents, the reality is more complicated, reports Clara Hernanz Lizarraga. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: US House to Weigh Penalties on AI Model Copying by Chinese Firms
highlights.description: House Republicans are calling for US sanctions against Chinese entities that improperly extract results from leading US artificial intelligence models to develop their own competing systems, part of a widening effort by Congress to counter China in the global AI race.

robotics.title: LimX CFO: China's Robotics Industry Not Crowded Enough
robotics.description: Jesse Liu, CFO of Shenzhen‑based robotics company LimX Dynamics, says China’s humanoid robotics industry is “not crowded enough,” citing insufficient resource allocation and a shortage of reserved talent. (Source: Bloomberg)

crypto.title: Bitcoin's quantum debate splits as Adam Back pushes optional upgrades over forced freeze
crypto.description: The Blockstream CEO told Paris Blockchain Week that Bitcoin should build quantum-resistant upgrades now, a day after Jameson Lopp proposed freezing vulnerable coins instead.

crypto.title: Bitcoin devs bet a quantum attacker will play nice with a ‘wait and react’ plan
crypto.description: BitMEX Research proposes a canary system that pays a bounty to the first quantum attacker and activates a network-wide freeze, offering an alternative to a fixed five-year timeline.

other.title: Así cambian los pueblos cuando llegan miles de millones en centros de datos
other.description: Las grandes tecnológicas dicen que el despliegue de la inteligencia artificial en Aragón está teniendo tanto éxito que debería servir de modelo para otras regiones de la Unión Europea. Para los vecinos, la realidad es más compleja.
